prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1193; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent the interests of our client in connection with a motor vehicle collision that occurred when the at-fault vehicle struck our client's vehicle while our client was making a left turn. Our client sustained injuries as a result of this collision and is currently receiving medical treatment.

Please direct all further communication regarding this matter, including any contact with our client, exclusively to this office. Do not contact our client directly, either by telephone or in writing.

We request that you provide the declarations page and the full policy limits for all coverages under the policy issued to your insured, including any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply, within thirty days of receipt of this letter.

We also demand that your company preserve all evidence relating to this collision. This includes photographs, dash camera or telematics data, recorded statements, claim file notes, adjuster reports, vehicle inspection records, and any electronic data from the vehicles involved. Failure to preserve such evidence may result in sanctions in any subsequent litigation.
